Definition: from G3019; Levitic, i.e. relating to the Levites:--Levitical.
BiblicalUsage: Leuïtikós means Levitical, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In Hebrews 7:11, "If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Levitical priesthood was never the end — if perfection had come by it, there would be no need of a priest after Melchizedek.
